description:
Cast Timeless Lotus by paying its mana cost.
When Timeless Lotus enters, Ultron triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a copy of Timeless Lotus that is a 2/2 Robot Villain creature.
Put the nontoken Timeless Lotus into your graveyard due to the legend rule
During your next turn, activate the Timeless Lotus token by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping the Timeless Lotus token.
Repeat from step 4.
